name: LuaJIT x64: each 64 KiB machine-code area must be within a signed 32-bit displacement of the interpreter, i.e. inside a (2 GiB - 64 KiB) window centred on lj_vm_exit_handler
required_postconditions: the area satisfies J->mcmin <= addr && addr + sz <= J->mcmax, where mcmax - mcmin == MCODE_RANGE64 == (1u << 31) - 0x10000u == 0x7fff0000
the window is centred on the first allocation's midpoint, initially lj_vm_exit_handler, so the area must be within about +-1 GiB of the interpreter's own code
every trace must be able to reach every other trace and the interpreter with one rel32 branch; the comment states MCODE_RANGE64 is deliberately only half the signed branch range
hints are probed 64 KiB-aligned; mcmin is rounded up to a 64 KiB boundary and the 64 KiB corners are avoided
the area is mapped PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE and mprotect'ed to PROT_READ|PROT_EXEC before execution (LUAJIT_SECURITY_MCODE != 0, the default)

failure_sink.description: after 16 outer attempts, each with up to 15 pseudo-random 64 KiB-aligned hints, it calls lj_trace_err(J, LJ_TRERR_MCODEAL) with the comment 'Give up. OS probably ignores hints?'. That aborts the trace; the JIT falls back to the interpreter and the program keeps running, slower.

source_locations.symbol: mcode_inrange: addr >= J->mcmin && addr + sz >= J->mcmin && addr + sz <= J->mcmax
mcode_setrange(J, (uintptr_t)(void *)lj_vm_exit_handler) - the window is anchored to interpreter code
mmap((void *)hint, sz, prot|MCPROT_CREATE, MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANONYMOUS|MCMAP_CREATE, -1, 0) - a plain hint, no MAP_FIXED
MCPROT_GEN MCPROT_RW / MCPROT_RUN MCPROT_RX under the default LUAJIT_SECURITY_MCODE != 0
_(\011, sizemcode, 64) - 'Size of each machine code area (in KBytes)'
_(\010, maxmcode, 2048) - 'Max. total size of all machine code areas (in KBytes)'

extraction_limitations: THE LOAD-BEARING CONSTRAINT IS NOT EXPRESSIBLE IN THIS SCHEMA. 'within +-1 GiB of lj_vm_exit_handler' is a constraint relating this mapping to an address the analyzer never sees. Everything encoded above is the residue that the schema can hold, and that residue is trivially satisfiable.
the 64 KiB hint alignment is a property of the probe, not of the mapping, so required_alignment is left unset.

x_campaign.rationale: Stripped of the relative-distance constraint the schema cannot carry, this is a 64 KiB anonymous RW mapping later mprotect'ed to RX - which the probe confirms works. I expect SUPPORTED, and I expect that to be an incomplete answer rather than a wrong one.
